prior_year_events.impact_description: The revision of the anticipated Ogden discount rate (to an assumed +0.25% for 2017) was reflected in the 2017 result and had an improved impact on UK Employers' Liability reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Worse than expected claims activity (2014 and prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was GBP 1,148.563m. No material prior-year reserve movement is evident from the claims development table (net basis), indicating broadly flat prior-year development for years up to 2015. Management cites offsetting factors including adverse large loss experience in Professional Lines, but an improved impact from the Ogden discount rate revision and claims inflation assumption adjustments which supported the overall reserve position.
raw_causal_phrases: despite adverse large loss experience in the Professional Lines portfolio
partly due to the improved impact of the Ogden table changes, including claims inflation assumptions on UK Employer's Liability reserves
The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.
This result includes the anticipated impact of revising the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) from -0.75% to +0.25%
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was presented. A gross movement note that excludes current-year activity was not found. The claims development table is presented only on a net-of-reinsurance basis; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived as 0.0 from the net triangle (fallback). exact_reserve_text not located (no explicit narrative sentence giving a gross PY movement). Reserve movement confidence lowered because the available triangle is net rather than gross.
